description_zh: 创建G号码组。仅AXG隐私号类型的号码池支持设置G号码组
name: CreateAxgGroup

parameters.help_en: The key of the phone number pool. Log on to the Phone Number Protection console (https://dypls.console.aliyun.com/dypls.htm#/account) and view the key of the phone number pool on the Number Pool Management page
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of number group G. If the name of number group G is not specified, the ID of number group G is used as the name of number group G.

The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
G号码组名称。如果未指定G号码组名称，将以G号码组的ID作为名称。

支持中文、英文和特殊字符（例如：!@#$^_"等），长度不超过16个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The remarks of number group G. The value must be 0 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
G号码组的备注信息。

支持中文、英文和特殊字符（例如：!@#$^_"等），长度不超过50个字符
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The phone numbers that you add to number group G. Separate multiple phone numbers with commas (,). A maximum of 200 phone numbers can be added to number group G
parameters.help_zh: 向新建的G号码组中添加的电话号码。多个号码之间用英文逗号（,）分隔，创建时最多添加200个号码
parameters.name: numbers

Code.description_en:
The response code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful.
Other values indicate that the request failed. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

GroupId.description_en: The ID of number group G. The value of this parameter is required when the [BindAxg]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110249.html） operation is called to add an AXG binding
GroupId.description_zh: 新建的G号码组的ID，即GID。通过接口[BindAXG]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110249.html）绑定号码时需要输入此参数
